messages:
samira: hi team :wave: first-week q — trying to run the example infra PR but the pipeline errors when it calls GH Actions via repo_dispatch. snippet below, getting 403

```
2024-06-10T15:12:03Z ERROR trigger: POST https://api.github.com/repos/redwood-inference/service/actions/workflows/ci.yml/dispatches 403 Forbidden - resource not accessible by integration
```

I can see the repo and the Buildkite pipeline is set up, but not sure which permission is missing. anyone know who manages the Buildkite GitHub App? @laura @miguel

laura: welcome aboard! :tada: that 403 usually means the GitHub App token doesn't have access to that repo or the app isn't installed on it. can you paste the pipeline snippet that does the dispatch? also pinging @devops-oncall to check the app install quickly.

samira: sure — from infra/pipelines/service.yml:

```
- command: |
    curl -X POST \n      -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.v3+json" \n      -H "Authorization: token $GITHUB_TOKEN" \n      https://api.github.com/repos/redwood-inference/service/actions/workflows/ci.yml/dispatches \n      -d '{\"ref\":\"main\"}'
```

samira: GITHUB_TOKEN is the env var Buildkite injects into the job.

miguel: quick question — is that the org app installation token or a user PAT? when the pipeline uses the GitHub App, the installation token is scoped by which repos the app was granted. if someone swapped it to a user token it could behave differently.

laura: also check org settings: https://github.com/organizations/redwood-inference/settings/installations search for \"Buildkite\" and confirm repo access. Buildkite has two modes: app vs user. if it's the app, it needs workflow/contents access to that repo.

devops-oncall: I'm looking now. buildkite app is installed but limited to a repo set. adding `service` to allowed repos. should propagate in ~30s. i'll re-run the dispatch once it's applied.

ci-bot: buildkite/job/4321 re-run requested by devops-oncall

samira: reran and the repo_dispatch now returns 204, GH Actions started. thanks!! :raised_hands:

laura: awesome. onboarding note: please open a tiny PR to infra/permissions.md documenting which repos need Buildkite app access and who to contact for installs. also consider wrapping the curl into scripts/dispatch.sh that uses the app token so it's easier to debug next time.

samira: will do. two follow-ups: 1) how do i request membership in the `ci-admins` GitHub team? 2) where's the internal doc on re-runs and collecting artifacts?

miguel: 1) file a request in #people-ops or DM @people-ops, they handle org team invites. 2) docs: https://internal.redwood/docs/ci/buildkite-runbook and https://internal.redwood/docs/ci/artifacts — i'll paste a short link in your PR review.

laura: if you hit flaky cache issues later, tag @eng-infra with the job id and `buildkite-agent artifact download` output. we have a checklist to triage cache vs runner image problems.

samira: super helpful, thanks all :heart: i'll update infra docs and @mention you on the PR.

miguel: welcome again! ping me if you want to pair on any bootcamp tasks. :coffee:
